title: Use {provider} in ChatGPT
sub: ChatGPT reaches {provider} through a custom MCP server, which you add on chatgpt.com with ChatGPT Go or a paid plan.
steps: Connect {provider} to MCPEmails with the steps above.
On chatgpt.com, open Plugins, Personal, click Add, then Add custom MCP server.
Name it MCPEmails, paste https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp under Connection, choose OAuth, confirm, click Create as a plugin and sign in to MCPEmails.
In a chat, type @ and pick MCPEmails. Do it again when a follow-up needs your mail.
blogLink: How to connect ChatGPT to your email
faqA: Yes, once {provider} is connected to MCPEmails. On chatgpt.com, add a custom MCP server with the URL https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp and OAuth sign-in. That works with ChatGPT Go and paid plans. ChatGPT gets only the access you approve, and your mail is fetched live, never stored.
directorySub: ChatGPT reaches {provider} through Any Mailbox, the MCPEmails plugin in the ChatGPT plugin directory.
directorySteps: Connect {provider} to MCPEmails with the steps above.
In ChatGPT, open Plugins, find Any Mailbox in the plugin directory and click Install plugin, then Connect.
Sign in to MCPEmails and choose which mailboxes ChatGPT can reach. In a chat, type @ and pick Any Mailbox.
directoryLink: Any Mailbox in the ChatGPT plugin directory
directoryFaqA: Yes, once {provider} is connected to MCPEmails. Install Any Mailbox from the ChatGPT plugin directory and sign in to MCPEmails. ChatGPT gets only the access you approve, and your mail is fetched live, never stored.
